_topic: Notes app — one note per section of your old portfolio
_help: These are the notes the Notes app opens with, ported from github.com/sidhxntt/sidhxntt/docs/index.html. Visitors can edit them in-app (changes live in their browser only), so this file is the starting state. Order here = order in the list.
_fields: id — stable key, never reuse or visitors keep the old copy · title — shown in the list and matched by Siri ('open my work experience note') · daysAgo — how far back the note is stamped, so the list groups into Today / Previous 7 Days / Previous 30 Days · body — markdown
_markdown: Bodies render formatted — the syntax is never shown. Use: ## section · ### subsection · **bold** · *italic* · __underline__ · `code` · - bullets · 1. numbered · > quote · --- divider · | tables | · [text](url) · ![alt](image-url). Never start a body with '# ' — the note's title already renders above it and the heading reads as a duplicate.
_composed: About Me, Skills, Work Experience and Domain Expertise pull their facts (stats, experience, expertise, skills) from 02-profile.json — edit them there, not here.

notes.title: Process Workflow
notes.body:
I take a **user-centric** approach to engineering, focusing on deeply understanding problems and rapidly prototyping solutions based on feedback. I emphasise clean, scalable code and intuitive design to build products that are both effective and easy to evolve.

## How a build actually goes

1. **Understand** — sit with the problem before touching an editor
2. **Prototype** — ship something rough and real, fast
3. **Listen** — feedback beats opinion, every time
4. **Harden** — tests, observability, and the boring parts that keep it alive
5. **Iterate** — repeat, with what you learned

> Good software is cultivated, not assembled.

## Browse my Styles.

A crisp list of the software development methodologies and principles I follow — the industry standards, widely used and accepted by the community.

| Principle | What it buys |
| --- | --- |
| **DRY** | one source of truth, one place to change it |
| **OOP** | state and behaviour that travel together |
| **SOLID** | five rules that keep code maintainable |
| **Agile** | iterate, ship, get feedback |
| **CI/CD** | an automated path to production |
